query: Who was known by his stage name Aladin and helped organizations improve their performance as a consultant?

pipeline_result.response: Aladin was known by his stage name, Aladin, who was a Bangladeshi-British cultural practitioner, magician, live artist, and former international management consultant. He played a significant role in improving the performance of organizations through his expertise and influence as a consultant.
retrieved_context: Eenasul Fateh: Eenasul Fateh (Bengali: ঈনাসুল ফাতেহ ; born 3 April 1959), also known by his stage name Aladin, is a Bangladeshi-British cultural practitioner, magician, live artist and former international management consultant.

Abdul Razzak Yaqoob: Abdul Razzak Yaqoob (Urdu: عبد الرزاق يعقوب‎ ; 7 May 1944–21 February 2014), popularly known by his name initials, as ARY, was a Pakistani media mogul, industrialist, philanthropist, and the businessman who founded and was the owner of the ARY Group of Companies.

Claudio Fernández-Aráoz: Claudio Fernández-Aráoz is an Argentinian author, international speaker and global expert on talent and leadership, ranked by "BusinessWeek" as one of the most influential executive search consultants in the world.  He is currently a senior adviser of Egon Zehnder.  Before joining Egon Zehnder in 1986, he worked at McKinsey & Company in Europe.  He is a frequent lecturer at the Harvard Business School.
sub_queries: Aladin, also known as Aladdin, is a stage name of Khalid Abdul-Haqq, an American actor and entrepreneur who has worked in various roles across multiple genres. He has been recognized for his philanthropic efforts by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and other organizations.
